title: Ally
text: Built an Accounts Receivable dashboard that gives the finance team a clear, real-time view of outstanding payments. Implemented data exchange between healthcare providers and insurance companies over the X12 EDI standard (837 claim and 835 remittance files).
Together with the team, delivered a new claims-processing system that streamlined communication between clients, caregivers and the company.

title: Porsche Digital Brochure
text: Single-handedly designed and built a CRM for the Swiss network of Porsche showrooms. From a tablet or desktop, sales consultants generate a personalised digital brochure for each client in minutes; built-in mailing and activity tracking show how clients engage with it.

Owned the full cycle from concept to release and shipped in three months, building on a CRM framework I had developed earlier. Automating routine work reduced managers' workload and contributed to higher sales.

title: Rocken
text: Recruitment platform that automates the company's recruiting workflows and lets candidates build their own CVs and search for vacancies.
Grew from developer to team lead of the product: assembled the team, introduced Git Flow and CI/CD, containerised the stack with Docker and deployed it as images on DigitalOcean for flexible scaling.
Implemented PostgreSQL full-text search with custom dictionaries and fuzzy matching, and optimised the database schema. Better candidate–vacancy matching drove traffic to 100,000+ monthly visits.

title: SeekingSimple.com
text: Healthy-lifestyle app that helps users make better food choices. Revived the product after a multi-year pause: upgraded the entire framework and library stack and migrated the frontend to Vue 3 with the Composition API.
Chose MongoDB as the core database to handle complex JSON from an external data provider, and built a separate CRM for coaches integrated with the mobile app and admin panel.
Introduced gamification — a points system, interactive prompts and themed browser games — which improved onboarding and user engagement.

title: TechPort
text: Dispatch scheduling system for a logistics company delivering construction materials 24/7. Built a custom shift calendar, since off-the-shelf libraries could not handle non-standard dynamic shifts, with day, week and month views showing who is loading, on which vehicle, and each vehicle's status per shift.
Added a live map with real-time vehicle tracking, so dispatchers monitor the fleet from the admin panel instead of calling every driver.
